description: This file defines a custom UI theme for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It manages dark and light theme configurations, adjusts status bar appearance, and provides color-related utility functions for the UI.

methods.name: OpenClawTheme
methods.description: Defines the application's theme, dynamically adjusting color schemes based on system dark mode setting and updating window status bar icons accordingly.

methods.name: overlayContainerColor
methods.description: Returns a Color for overlay container backgrounds, adapting to dark/light themes and adding transparency in light mode.

methods.name: overlayIconColor
methods.description: Provides the color for overlay icons, based on the current theme's onSurfaceVariant color scheme.
